title: UI: timeline frame counter shows padded MIN_VISIBLE_FRAMES (48) instead of actual content frame count
description: Fixed: extracted contentFrameCount() (unpadded) from totalFrameCount() (padded to MIN_VISIBLE_FRAMES=48). The FrameCounterInput now receives displayFrameCount (unpadded) so the readout shows the real content length (e.g. '1 / 2' for golden.fla) while the grid still renders all 48 padding columns. Also exported contentFrameCount and added timelineFrameCounter.test.ts with 4 unit tests. All 632 tests pass, tsc clean.
